items.title: 9.2.3.1 Software for Business Plan Creation (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.2.2.1 (PDF 211), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Kai software maujood hain jo business plan banana aasan kar dete hain. Yeh tools tayyar sanche (structured templates), financial modeling (paise ke hisab ka model banana) ki sahoolat aur rehnumai dete hain, jis se aap ka business plan wazeh aur tafseeli banta hai.

Misal: farz karein aap chhoti si online kitabon ki dukaan (bookstore) kholna chahte hain. PlanGuru ya Enloop jaise business plan software mein aap retail (parchoon farokht) karobar ke liye bana hua template chun sakte hain. Software aap ko business overview aur market analysis jaise hisse likhne mein qadam ba qadam rehnumai dega.

In tools mein aksar financial calculators hote hain jin mein aap inventory, website banane aur marketing ke kharche daal sakte hain. Phir software financial projections (aane wale waqt ke maali andaze) bana deta hai, jaise andazan sales aur cash flow (paisa aane aur jane ka hisab), aur saath charts aur graphs bhi. Is se investors ke saamne plan pesh karna ya funding (sarmaya) ke liye darkhwast dena aasan ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Cash flow kya hai, aur is ka andaza lagana kyun zaroori hai?
blocks.explanation: Cash flow woh paisa hai jo waqt ke saath karobar mein aata aur jata hai. Is ka andaza dikhata hai ke har mahine bill aur kharche ada karne ke liye kafi naqd paisa hoga ya nahi. Yeh definition aam maloomat se hai; kitab sirf naam leti hai.

items: Business plan software: templates, financial calculators, charts aur graphs (PlanGuru, Enloop).
